race.comment: BENNY BE GOOD (5) was last seen getting around 350m at this track in a strong 19.33 for a 1.75 lengths win. Can measure up again if runs up to latest time. HARD SMALL TOWN (1) stalked lead from an outside box last start before finishing third (22.78) at Geelong in a Mix 6/7 over 400m. Must be included in calculations. DOWNER ROAD (7) is progressing well claiming his 2nd career win latest, scoring by 4.5 lengths (19.38) at this track. Winner at his latest appearance in one of the quickest times on the card. In top form and looks a key chance again. MYSTIC RUPEE (2) clocked the best time of the meeting last time. Sure to run well again.
